description: Land Acquisition - Ibbagamuwa, Ibbagamuwa D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2035/11 of 23.01.2018 Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Korale D/S Division, Kandy District
categorisation: This gazette content is primarily about land acquisition by the state for public purposes, detailing specific land parcels, their descriptions, claimants, and extents. It falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act, not government structure/personnel or other specialized categories.
